newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey says killed six Kurd rebels in southeast.
newsitem.headline: Turkey says killed six Kurd rebels in southeast.

text.p: Turkish forces killed six Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) rebels in a clash in the southeastern province of Bingol, officials at the emergency rule governor's office in Diyarbakir said on Monday.
They said the clash took place near the village of Cevirme in Bingol province late on Sunday. Two of the dead guerrillas were women.
Turkish forces are engaged in a six-week operation against the PKK in neighbouring northern Iraq, which the rebels use as a base for raids into Turkey.
State-run Anatolian news agency on Monday reported the funeral of one soldier killed in fighting with the PKK but did not say when or where he died.
More than 24,000 people have been killed in the conflict between Turkish security forces and the PKK, fighting for 12 years for autonomy or independence in the mainly Kurdish southeast.
